Bias Data Playground

transformPoint = (bx, by, p) => {
  const nx = p.std_x * bx;
  const ny = p.corr * p.std_y * bx + p.std_y * Math.sqrt(1 - p.corr * p.corr) * by;
  return [nx, ny];
}
active_data = {
  const n_female = Math.floor(total_samples * minority_ratio);
  const n_male = total_samples - n_female;
  const n_female_pos = Math.floor(n_female * positive_ratio);
  const n_female_neg = n_female - n_female_pos;
  const n_male_pos = Math.floor(n_male * positive_ratio);
  const n_male_neg = n_male - n_male_pos;

  const applyNoise = (data, count, originalClass, flippedClass, noiseRatio) => {
    const nFlipped = Math.floor(count * noiseRatio);
    return data.slice(0, count).map((d, i) => ({
      ...d,
      original_class: originalClass,
      class: i < nFlipped ? flippedClass : originalClass,
      is_noise: i < nFlipped // Let's also track if a point was flipped just in case you need it later
    }));
  };

  return [
    ...applyNoise(male_neg_pool, n_male_neg, "Negative", "Positive", params_mn.noise),
    ...applyNoise(male_pos_pool, n_male_pos, "Positive", "Negative", params_mp.noise),
    ...applyNoise(female_neg_pool, n_female_neg, "Negative", "Positive", params_fn.noise),
    ...applyNoise(female_pos_pool, n_female_pos, "Positive", "Negative", params_fp.noise)
  ];
}
// Fixed balanced test set: 250 per group, 50/50 class split
// Drawn from the END of the pools (indices 1500–1999) to avoid overlap with training data
test_pool = {
  const N = 250; // per group
  const half = N / 2;
  return [
    ...male_neg_pool.slice(1500, 1500 + half).map(d => ({...d, test_group: "Male",   test_class: "Negative"})),
    ...male_pos_pool.slice(1500, 1500 + half).map(d => ({...d, test_group: "Male",   test_class: "Positive"})),
    ...female_neg_pool.slice(1500, 1500 + half).map(d => ({...d, test_group: "Female", test_class: "Negative"})),
    ...female_pos_pool.slice(1500, 1500 + half).map(d => ({...d, test_group: "Female", test_class: "Positive"}))
  ];
}
d3 = require("d3@7")

// ── Layout shell ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
layout = {
  const root = document.createElement("div");
  root.id = "playground-layout";

  // ── SIDEBAR ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const sidebar = document.createElement("div");
  sidebar.id = "sidebar";

  // Legend section
  const legendSection = document.createElement("div");
  legendSection.innerHTML = `
    <p class="sidebar-section-title">Legend</p>
    <div class="legend-card">
      <div class="legend-grid">
        <div class="legend-item">
          <svg width="12" height="12"><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="5" fill="#d62728"/></svg> Male Negative
        </div>
        <div class="legend-item">
          <svg width="12" height="12"><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="5" fill="#1f77b4"/></svg> Male Positive
        </div>
        <div class="legend-item">
          <svg width="12" height="12"><path d="M2,2 L10,10 M10,2 L2,10" stroke="#d62728" stroke-width="2.5"/></svg> Female Negative
        </div>
        <div class="legend-item">
          <svg width="12" height="12"><path d="M2,2 L10,10 M10,2 L2,10" stroke="#1f77b4" stroke-width="2.5"/></svg> Female Positive
        </div>
        <div class="legend-item" style="grid-column:1/-1;margin-top:0.25rem">
          <svg width="22" height="12"><line x1="0" y1="6" x2="22" y2="6" stroke="#fbbf24" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/></svg> Decision Boundary
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  // Controls section
  const controlsSection = document.createElement("div");
  const controlsTitle = document.createElement("p");
  controlsTitle.className = "sidebar-section-title";
  controlsTitle.textContent = "Parameters";

  const controlsCard = document.createElement("div");
  controlsCard.className = "controls-card";
  const makeGroupDetails = (title, formElement) => {
    const d = document.createElement("details");
    d.style.marginBottom = "0.5rem";
    d.innerHTML = `<summary class="sidebar-section-title" style="cursor:pointer; padding-top:0.25rem;">${title}</summary>`;
    const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
    wrapper.style.padding = "0.25rem 0 0 0.25rem";
    wrapper.append(formElement);
    d.append(wrapper);
    return d;
  };

  controlsCard.append(
    viewof_total_samples,
    viewof_class_separation,
    viewof_group_disparity,
    viewof_positive_ratio,
    viewof_minority_ratio,
    document.createElement("hr"),
    makeGroupDetails("Male Positive", viewof_params_mp),
    makeGroupDetails("Male Negative", viewof_params_mn),
    makeGroupDetails("Female Positive", viewof_params_fp),
    makeGroupDetails("Female Negative", viewof_params_fn)
  );

  controlsSection.append(controlsTitle, controlsCard);
  sidebar.append(legendSection, controlsSection);

  // ── Main right area: results on top, charts below ─────────────────────────
  const chartAndResults = document.createElement("div");
  chartAndResults.id = "chart-and-results";

  // ── Results panel at TOP ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const resultsPanel = document.createElement("div");
  resultsPanel.id = "results-panel";
  resultsPanel.innerHTML = `
    <div class="results-header">
      <div class="results-title-container">
        <p class="results-title">Model Performance</p>
        <p class="results-subtitle">Balanced test set · 125 per group×class · never seen during training</p>
      </div>
      <div class="results-actions" id="results-actions"></div>
    </div>
    <div id="results-empty" class="results-empty">
      <p style="margin:0;font-size:0.78rem;color:#334155">Train a model to see per-group performance</p>
    </div>
    <div class="results-grid" id="results-grid"></div>
  `;

  // Model type toggle
  const modelToggle = document.createElement("div");
  modelToggle.className = "model-toggle";
  modelToggle.append(viewof_model_type);

  const trainBtn = document.createElement("button");
  trainBtn.className = "train-btn";
  trainBtn.id = "train-btn";
  trainBtn.innerHTML = `<span class="btn-spinner"></span> <span id="train-btn-label">Train Model</span>`;
  trainBtn.addEventListener("click", () => window._trainModel && window._trainModel());

  const resultsActions = resultsPanel.querySelector("#results-actions");
  resultsActions.append(modelToggle, trainBtn);

  // ── Two charts side by side ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const chartsRow = document.createElement("div");
  chartsRow.id = "charts-row";

  // Training chart
  const chartArea = document.createElement("div");
  chartArea.id = "chart-area";
  const chartHeader = document.createElement("div");
  chartHeader.className = "chart-header";
  chartHeader.innerHTML = `<p class="chart-title">Training Set</p><p class="chart-subtitle">Adjust parameters to explore group dynamics</p>`;
  const chartContainer = document.createElement("div");
  chartContainer.className = "chart-container"; chartContainer.id = "chart-container";
  chartArea.append(chartHeader, chartContainer);

  // Test chart
  const testChartArea = document.createElement("div");
  testChartArea.id = "test-chart-area";
  testChartArea.innerHTML = `
    <div class="chart-header">
      <p class="chart-title">Test Set</p>
      <p class="chart-subtitle">Balanced · 500 samples · never seen during training</p>
    </div>
    <div class="chart-container" id="test-chart-container">
      <div id="test-chart-empty" class="results-empty" style="padding:1rem">
        <p style="margin:0;font-size:0.78rem;color:#334155">Train a model to see the test distribution</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  chartsRow.append(chartArea, testChartArea);
  chartAndResults.append(resultsPanel, chartsRow);
  root.append(sidebar, chartAndResults);
  return root;
}

viewof_model_type = {
  const root = document.createElement("div");
  root.className = "model-toggle-group";
  const options = [{value: "lr", label: "Logistic Reg."}, {value: "mlp", label: "MLP  2·16·32·1"}];
  let val = "lr";
  const btns = options.map(opt => {
    const b = document.createElement("button");
    b.className = "model-toggle-btn" + (opt.value === val ? " active" : "");
    b.textContent = opt.label;
    b.addEventListener("click", () => {
      val = opt.value;
      btns.forEach(x => x.classList.remove("active"));
      b.classList.add("active");
      root.value = val;
      root.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input"));
      const lbl = document.getElementById("train-btn-label");
      if (lbl) lbl.textContent = "Train Model"
    });
    return b;
  });
  btns.forEach(b => root.appendChild(b));
  root.value = val;
  return root;
}

model_type = Generators.input(viewof_model_type)

viewof_total_samples  = Inputs.range([100, 2000], {value: 500,  step: 50,   label: "Total Samples"})
viewof_class_separation = Inputs.range([0, 6],    {value: 3,    step: 0.1,  label: "Class Separation (Y)"})
viewof_group_disparity  = Inputs.range([0, 6],    {value: 3,    step: 0.1,  label: "Group Separation (X)"})
viewof_positive_ratio = Inputs.range([0.05, 0.95],{value: 0.5,  step: 0.05, label: "Positive Ratio"})
viewof_minority_ratio = Inputs.range([0.05, 0.95],{value: 0.5,  step: 0.05, label: "Female Ratio"})

makeParamsForm = () => Inputs.form({
  std_x: Inputs.range([0.1, 3], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "Spread X"}),
  std_y: Inputs.range([0.1, 3], {value: 1, step: 0.1, label: "Spread Y"}),
  corr:  Inputs.range([-0.95, 0.95], {value: 0, step: 0.05, label: "Correlation"}),
  noise: Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: 0, step: 0.01, label: "Noise"})
});

viewof_params_mp = makeParamsForm()
viewof_params_mn = makeParamsForm()
viewof_params_fp = makeParamsForm()
viewof_params_fn = makeParamsForm()

total_samples     = Generators.input(viewof_total_samples)
class_separation  = Generators.input(viewof_class_separation)
group_disparity   = Generators.input(viewof_group_disparity)
positive_ratio    = Generators.input(viewof_positive_ratio)
minority_ratio    = Generators.input(viewof_minority_ratio)
params_mp         = Generators.input(viewof_params_mp)
params_mn         = Generators.input(viewof_params_mn)
params_fp         = Generators.input(viewof_params_fp)
params_fn         = Generators.input(viewof_params_fn)
chart = {
  // Dimensions — square aspect ratio
  const container = document.getElementById("chart-container");
  const size = Math.max((container?.clientWidth || 520) - 30, 320);
  const W = size;
  const H = size;
  const margin = {top: 24, right: 24, bottom: 48, left: 52};
  const innerW = W - margin.left - margin.right;
  const innerH = H - margin.top - margin.bottom;

  // Color map
  const getColor = d => d.class === "Positive" ? "#1f77b4" : "#d62728";

  const symbolGenerator = d3.symbol();

  const getPath = (d, size) => {
    symbolGenerator.type(d.group === "Male" ? d3.symbolCircle : d3.symbolCross).size(size);
    return symbolGenerator();
  };

  // Scales
  const xScale = d3.scaleLinear().domain([-4, 10]).range([0, innerW]);
  const yScale = d3.scaleLinear().domain([-4, 10]).range([innerH, 0]);

  // Build/reuse SVG
  let svg = d3.select("#chart-container svg");
  if (svg.empty()) {
    svg = d3.select("#chart-container")
      .append("svg")
      .attr("width", W)
      .attr("height", H)
      .style("display", "block");
  } else {
    svg.attr("width", W).attr("height", H);
  }

  let defs = svg.select("defs");
  if (defs.empty()) defs = svg.append("defs");
  let clip = defs.select("#main-clip");
  if (clip.empty()) {
    clip = defs.append("clipPath").attr("id", "main-clip");
    clip.append("rect");
  }
  clip.select("rect").attr("width", innerW).attr("height", innerH);

  let g = svg.select("g.inner");
  if (g.empty()) {
    g = svg.append("g").attr("class", "inner")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${margin.left},${margin.top})`);
  }

  let plotArea = g.select(".plot-area");
  if (plotArea.empty()) {
    plotArea = g.append("g").attr("class", "plot-area").attr("clip-path", "url(#main-clip)");
  }

  // Grid lines
  let gridGroup = g.select(".grid");
  if (gridGroup.empty()) gridGroup = g.append("g").attr("class", "grid");
  gridGroup.selectAll(".grid-h")
    .data(yScale.ticks(6))
    .join("line").attr("class","grid-h")
    .attr("x1", 0).attr("x2", innerW)
    .attr("y1", d => yScale(d)).attr("y2", d => yScale(d))
    .attr("stroke", "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)").attr("stroke-width", 1);
  gridGroup.selectAll(".grid-v")
    .data(xScale.ticks(6))
    .join("line").attr("class","grid-v")
    .attr("x1", d => xScale(d)).attr("x2", d => xScale(d))
    .attr("y1", 0).attr("y2", innerH)
    .attr("stroke", "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)").attr("stroke-width", 1);

  // Axes
  let xAxisG = g.select(".x-axis");
  if (xAxisG.empty()) xAxisG = g.append("g").attr("class","x-axis");
  xAxisG.attr("transform", `translate(0,${innerH})`)
    .call(d3.axisBottom(xScale).ticks(6).tickSize(4))
    .call(ax => {
      ax.select(".domain").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.15)");
      ax.selectAll("text").attr("fill","#64748b").attr("font-size","11px").attr("font-family","Inter,sans-serif");
      ax.selectAll(".tick line").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.1)");
    });

  let yAxisG = g.select(".y-axis");
  if (yAxisG.empty()) yAxisG = g.append("g").attr("class","y-axis");
  yAxisG.call(d3.axisLeft(yScale).ticks(6).tickSize(4))
    .call(ax => {
      ax.select(".domain").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.15)");
      ax.selectAll("text").attr("fill","#64748b").attr("font-size","11px").attr("font-family","Inter,sans-serif");
      ax.selectAll(".tick line").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.1)");
    });

  // Axis labels
  let xLabel = g.select(".x-label");
  if (xLabel.empty()) {
    g.append("text").attr("class","x-label")
      .attr("x", innerW / 2).attr("y", innerH + 40)
      .attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("fill","#475569")
      .attr("font-size","11px").attr("font-family","Inter,sans-serif")
      .text("Feature X  (Group Disparity axis)");
  }
  let yLabel = g.select(".y-label");
  if (yLabel.empty()) {
    g.append("text").attr("class","y-label")
      .attr("transform","rotate(-90)")
      .attr("x", -innerH / 2).attr("y", -40)
      .attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("fill","#475569")
      .attr("font-size","11px").attr("font-family","Inter,sans-serif")
      .text("Feature Y  (Class Separation axis)");
  }

  const getP = (g, c) => (g === "Male") ? (c === "Positive" ? params_mp : params_mn) : (c === "Positive" ? params_fp : params_fn);

  // Points
  const getX = d => {
    const [nx, ny] = transformPoint(d.base_x, d.base_y, getP(d.group, d.original_class));
    return xScale(nx + (d.group === "Female" ? group_disparity : 0));
  };
  const getY = d => {
    const [nx, ny] = transformPoint(d.base_x, d.base_y, getP(d.group, d.original_class));
    return yScale(ny + (d.original_class === "Positive" ? class_separation : 0));
  };

  plotArea.selectAll("path.point")
    .data(active_data, d => d.id)
    .join(
      enter => enter.append("path")
        .attr("class", "point")
        .attr("transform", d => `translate(${getX(d)},${getY(d)})`)
        .attr("d", d => getPath(d, 0))
        .attr("fill", getColor).attr("opacity", 0)
        .call(e => e.transition().duration(450)
          .attr("d", d => getPath(d, 60)).attr("opacity", 0.72)),
      update => update.call(u => u.transition().duration(450)
        .attr("transform", d => `translate(${getX(d)},${getY(d)})`)
        .attr("d", d => getPath(d, 60))
        .attr("fill", getColor).attr("opacity", 0.72)),
      exit => exit.call(x => x.transition().duration(280)
        .attr("d", d => getPath(d, 0)).attr("opacity", 0).remove())
    );

  // ── Decision boundary: training chart ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  const drawContour = (targetG, xSc, ySc) => {
    const m = window._model;
    if (!m || !m.predictNorm) return;
    const GRID = 80;
    
    // Pad domain slightly so the closed edges of the contour fall outside the SVG clipPath
    const oX = xSc.domain(), oY = ySc.domain();
    const px = (oX[1] - oX[0]) * 0.1, py = (oY[1] - oY[0]) * 0.1;
    const xDom = [oX[0] - px, oX[1] + px], yDom = [oY[0] - py, oY[1] + py];

    const xStep = (xDom[1] - xDom[0]) / GRID, yStep = (yDom[1] - yDom[0]) / GRID;
    const Wg = GRID + 1, Hg = GRID + 1;
    const vals = new Float64Array(Wg * Hg);
    for (let r = 0; r < Hg; r++) {
      const yv = yDom[1] - r * yStep;
      for (let c = 0; c < Wg; c++)
        vals[r * Wg + c] = m.predictNorm(...m.norm(xDom[0] + c * xStep, yv));
    }
    const cd = d3.contours().size([Wg, Hg]).thresholds([0.5])(vals);
    const pg = d3.geoPath().projection(
      d3.geoTransform({ point(c, r) { this.stream.point(xSc(xDom[0]+c*xStep), ySc(yDom[1]-r*yStep)); } })
    );
    let gl = targetG.select(".boundary-glow");
    if (gl.empty()) gl = targetG.insert("g", ".point").attr("class", "boundary-glow");
    gl.selectAll("path").data(cd).join("path").attr("d", pg)
      .attr("fill","none").attr("stroke","rgba(250,204,21,0.15)").attr("stroke-width",12)
      .attr("stroke-linejoin","round").attr("opacity",0).transition().duration(700).attr("opacity",1);
    let ln = targetG.select(".boundary-line");
    if (ln.empty()) ln = targetG.insert("g", ".point").attr("class", "boundary-line");
    ln.selectAll("path").data(cd).join("path").attr("d", pg)
      .attr("fill","none").attr("stroke","#fbbf24").attr("stroke-width",2)
      .attr("stroke-dasharray","7 4").attr("stroke-linejoin","round")
      .attr("opacity",0).transition().duration(700).attr("opacity",0.9);
  };

  window._drawBoundary = () => drawContour(plotArea, xScale, yScale);

  // ── Test chart draw function (redraws on slider change if model exists) ─────
  window._drawTestChart = () => {
    const m = window._model;
    if (!m || !m.predictNorm) return;
    const tc = document.getElementById("test-chart-container");
    if (!tc) return;
    const empty = document.getElementById("test-chart-empty");
    if (empty) empty.style.display = "none";

    const sz = Math.max((tc.clientWidth || 520) - 30, 320);
    const marg = {top: 24, right: 24, bottom: 48, left: 52};
    const iW = sz - marg.left - marg.right, iH = sz - marg.top - marg.bottom;
    const xSc = d3.scaleLinear().domain([-4, 10]).range([0, iW]);
    const ySc = d3.scaleLinear().domain([-4, 10]).range([iH, 0]);

    let tsvg = d3.select("#test-chart-container svg");
    if (tsvg.empty()) {
      tsvg = d3.select("#test-chart-container").append("svg")
        .attr("width", sz).attr("height", sz).style("display", "block");
    } else { tsvg.attr("width", sz).attr("height", sz); }

    let tdefs = tsvg.select("defs");
    if (tdefs.empty()) tdefs = tsvg.append("defs");
    let tclip = tdefs.select("#test-clip");
    if (tclip.empty()) {
      tclip = tdefs.append("clipPath").attr("id", "test-clip");
      tclip.append("rect");
    }
    tclip.select("rect").attr("width", iW).attr("height", iH);

    let tg = tsvg.select("g.inner");
    if (tg.empty()) tg = tsvg.append("g").attr("class","inner").attr("transform",`translate(${marg.left},${marg.top})`);

    let tPlotArea = tg.select(".plot-area");
    if (tPlotArea.empty()) {
      tPlotArea = tg.append("g").attr("class", "plot-area").attr("clip-path", "url(#test-clip)");
    }

    // Grid
    let gridG = tg.select(".grid"); if (gridG.empty()) gridG = tg.append("g").attr("class","grid");
    gridG.selectAll(".gh").data(ySc.ticks(6)).join("line").attr("class","gh")
      .attr("x1",0).attr("x2",iW).attr("y1",d=>ySc(d)).attr("y2",d=>ySc(d))
      .attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.05)").attr("stroke-width",1);
    gridG.selectAll(".gv").data(xSc.ticks(6)).join("line").attr("class","gv")
      .attr("x1",d=>xSc(d)).attr("x2",d=>xSc(d)).attr("y1",0).attr("y2",iH)
      .attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.05)").attr("stroke-width",1);

    // Axes
    let xAg = tg.select(".x-axis"); if (xAg.empty()) xAg = tg.append("g").attr("class","x-axis");
    xAg.attr("transform",`translate(0,${iH})`).call(d3.axisBottom(xSc).ticks(6).tickSize(4))
      .call(ax => { ax.select(".domain").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.15)");
        ax.selectAll("text").attr("fill","#64748b").attr("font-size","11px").attr("font-family","Inter,sans-serif");
        ax.selectAll(".tick line").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.1)"); });
    let yAg = tg.select(".y-axis"); if (yAg.empty()) yAg = tg.append("g").attr("class","y-axis");
    yAg.call(d3.axisLeft(ySc).ticks(6).tickSize(4))
      .call(ax => { ax.select(".domain").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.15)");
        ax.selectAll("text").attr("fill","#64748b").attr("font-size","11px").attr("font-family","Inter,sans-serif");
        ax.selectAll(".tick line").attr("stroke","rgba(255,255,255,0.1)"); });

    // Test points (colored by true class, shaped by group)
    const sym = d3.symbol();
    const getTestX = d => {
      const [nx, ny] = transformPoint(d.base_x, d.base_y, getP(d.test_group, d.test_class));
      return xSc(nx + (d.test_group === "Female" ? group_disparity : 0));
    };
    const getTestY = d => {
      const [nx, ny] = transformPoint(d.base_x, d.base_y, getP(d.test_group, d.test_class));
      return ySc(ny + (d.test_class === "Positive" ? class_separation : 0));
    };
    const getTestColor = d => d.test_class === "Positive" ? "#1f77b4" : "#d62728";
    const getTestPath = (d, s) => { sym.type(d.test_group==="Male" ? d3.symbolCircle : d3.symbolCross).size(s); return sym(); };

    tPlotArea.selectAll("path.tpoint")
      .data(test_pool, d => d.id)
      .join(
        enter => enter.append("path").attr("class","tpoint")
          .attr("transform", d => `translate(${getTestX(d)},${getTestY(d)})`)
          .attr("d", d => getTestPath(d, 0)).attr("fill", getTestColor).attr("opacity",0)
          .call(e => e.transition().duration(450).attr("d", d=>getTestPath(d,60)).attr("opacity",0.72)),
        update => update.call(u => u.transition().duration(450)
          .attr("transform", d => `translate(${getTestX(d)},${getTestY(d)})`)
          .attr("d", d => getTestPath(d,60)).attr("fill", getTestColor).attr("opacity",0.72)),
        exit => exit.call(x => x.transition().duration(280).attr("d",d=>getTestPath(d,0)).attr("opacity",0).remove())
      );

    // Decision boundary on test chart
    drawContour(tPlotArea, xSc, ySc);
  };

  if (window._model) { window._drawBoundary(); window._drawTestChart(); }

  return null;
}
train_trigger = {
  // Expose training fn to the button via window
  window._trainModel = () => {
    const btn = document.getElementById("train-btn");
    if (btn) { btn.classList.add("loading"); btn.querySelector(".btn-spinner").style.display = "block"; }

    // Small delay so the spinner renders before the JS blocks the thread
    setTimeout(() => {
      // ── 1. Build feature matrix from active_data ──────────────────────────
      const getP = (g, c) => (g === "Male") ? (c === "Positive" ? params_mp : params_mn) : (c === "Positive" ? params_fp : params_fn);

      const featurize = (d, gDisp, cSep) => {
        const [nx, ny] = transformPoint(d.base_x, d.base_y, getP(d.group, d.original_class || d.class));
        return [
          nx + (d.group === "Female" ? gDisp : 0),
          ny + ((d.original_class || d.class) === "Positive" ? cSep : 0)
        ];
      };

      const X_train = active_data.map(d => featurize(d, group_disparity, class_separation));
      const y_train = active_data.map(d => d.class === "Positive" ? 1 : 0);

      // Standardize (mean/std from training set)
      const mean0 = X_train.reduce((s,x)=>s+x[0],0)/X_train.length;
      const mean1 = X_train.reduce((s,x)=>s+x[1],0)/X_train.length;
      const std0  = Math.sqrt(X_train.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x[0]-mean0)**2,0)/X_train.length) || 1;
      const std1  = Math.sqrt(X_train.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x[1]-mean1)**2,0)/X_train.length) || 1;
      const Xn = X_train.map(([a, b]) => [(a - mean0) / std0, (b - mean1) / std1]);

      // ── 2. Train selected model ───────────────────────────────────────────
      const sigmoid = z => 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-Math.max(-30, Math.min(30, z))));
      const normFn  = (xv, yv) => [(xv - mean0) / std0, (yv - mean1) / std1];

      let predictNorm; // (xn, yn) -> probability

      if (model_type === "mlp") {
        // ── MLP [2 → 16 → 32 → 1], ReLU hidden layers, sigmoid output ────────
        const H1 = 16, H2 = 32, lr_mlp = 0.05, ep_mlp = 600;

        // Layer 1: [2 → H1]
        const W1 = Float64Array.from({length: H1*2},  () => (Math.random()*2-1) * Math.sqrt(2/2));
        const b1 = new Float64Array(H1);
        // Layer 2: [H1 → H2]
        const W2 = Float64Array.from({length: H2*H1}, () => (Math.random()*2-1) * Math.sqrt(2/H1));
        const b2 = new Float64Array(H2);
        // Output: [H2 → 1]
        const W3 = Float64Array.from({length: H2},    () => (Math.random()*2-1) * Math.sqrt(2/H2));
        let   b3 = 0;

        const fwdMLP = (x0, x1) => {
          // Layer 1
          const z1 = new Float64Array(H1), a1 = new Float64Array(H1);
          for (let j = 0; j < H1; j++) {
            z1[j] = W1[j*2]*x0 + W1[j*2+1]*x1 + b1[j];
            a1[j] = Math.max(0, z1[j]);
          }
          // Layer 2
          const z2 = new Float64Array(H2), a2 = new Float64Array(H2);
          for (let k = 0; k < H2; k++) {
            let s = b2[k];
            for (let j = 0; j < H1; j++) s += W2[k*H1+j] * a1[j];
            z2[k] = s;
            a2[k] = Math.max(0, s);
          }
          // Output
          let z3 = b3;
          for (let k = 0; k < H2; k++) z3 += W3[k] * a2[k];
          return { prob: sigmoid(z3), z1, a1, z2, a2 };
        };

        for (let ep = 0; ep < ep_mlp; ep++) {
          const dW1 = new Float64Array(H1*2),  db1 = new Float64Array(H1);
          const dW2 = new Float64Array(H2*H1), db2 = new Float64Array(H2);
          const dW3 = new Float64Array(H2);    let db3g = 0;

          for (let i = 0; i < Xn.length; i++) {
            const { prob, z1, a1, z2, a2 } = fwdMLP(Xn[i][0], Xn[i][1]);
            // Output gradient
            const dz3 = prob - y_train[i];
            for (let k = 0; k < H2; k++) dW3[k] += dz3 * a2[k];
            db3g += dz3;
            // Layer 2 gradient
            for (let k = 0; k < H2; k++) {
              const da2 = dz3 * W3[k];
              const dz2k = z2[k] > 0 ? da2 : 0;
              db2[k] += dz2k;
              for (let j = 0; j < H1; j++) {
                dW2[k*H1+j] += dz2k * a1[j];
              }
              // Accumulate dL/da1
              // (handled per-j below for efficiency)
            }
            // Layer 1 gradient
            for (let j = 0; j < H1; j++) {
              let da1 = 0;
              for (let k = 0; k < H2; k++) {
                const dz2k = z2[k] > 0 ? (dz3 * W3[k]) : 0;
                da1 += dz2k * W2[k*H1+j];
              }
              const dz1j = z1[j] > 0 ? da1 : 0;
              dW1[j*2]   += dz1j * Xn[i][0];
              dW1[j*2+1] += dz1j * Xn[i][1];
              db1[j]     += dz1j;
            }
          }

          const n = Xn.length;
          for (let j = 0; j < H1*2;  j++) W1[j] -= lr_mlp * dW1[j] / n;
          for (let j = 0; j < H1;    j++) b1[j] -= lr_mlp * db1[j] / n;
          for (let k = 0; k < H2*H1; k++) W2[k] -= lr_mlp * dW2[k] / n;
          for (let k = 0; k < H2;    k++) { b2[k] -= lr_mlp * db2[k] / n; W3[k] -= lr_mlp * dW3[k] / n; }
          b3 -= lr_mlp * db3g / n;
        }
        predictNorm = (xn, yn) => fwdMLP(xn, yn).prob;


      } else {
        // ── Logistic Regression via GD ─────────────────────────────────
        let w = [0, 0], bias = 0;
        const lr = 0.1, epochs = 200;
        for (let ep = 0; ep < epochs; ep++) {
          let gw0 = 0, gw1 = 0, gb = 0;
          for (let i = 0; i < Xn.length; i++) {
            const pred = sigmoid(w[0]*Xn[i][0] + w[1]*Xn[i][1] + bias);
            const err  = pred - y_train[i];
            gw0 += err * Xn[i][0]; gw1 += err * Xn[i][1]; gb += err;
          }
          const n = Xn.length;
          w[0] -= lr * gw0 / n; w[1] -= lr * gw1 / n; bias -= lr * gb / n;
        }
        predictNorm = (xn, yn) => sigmoid(w[0]*xn + w[1]*yn + bias);
      }

      // Store model for boundary drawing
      window._model = { predictNorm, norm: normFn };

      // ── 3. Evaluate on fixed balanced test set ────────────────────────────
      // Test pool points use test_group / test_class fields
      const featurize_test = (d, gDisp, cSep) => {
        const [nx, ny] = transformPoint(d.base_x, d.base_y, getP(d.test_group, d.test_class));
        return [
          nx + (d.test_group === "Female" ? gDisp : 0),
          ny + (d.test_class === "Positive" ? cSep : 0)
        ];
      };

      const predict = d => {
        const [xv, yv] = featurize_test(d, group_disparity, class_separation);
        return predictNorm(...normFn(xv, yv)) >= 0.5 ? "Positive" : "Negative";
      };

      const groups = [
        { key: "Male",   label: "Male",   color: "#1f77b4" },
        { key: "Female", label: "Female", color: "#d62728" }
      ];
      const classes = ["Positive", "Negative"];

      const results = groups.map(grp => {
        const groupData = test_pool.filter(d => d.test_group === grp.key);
        const metrics = classes.map(cls => {
          const subset  = groupData.filter(d => d.test_class === cls);
          const correct = subset.filter(d => predict(d) === cls).length;
          // Precision & Recall for this class within this group
          const predicted_pos = groupData.filter(d => predict(d) === cls);
          const tp = predicted_pos.filter(d => d.test_class === cls).length;
          const precision = predicted_pos.length > 0 ? tp / predicted_pos.length : 0;
          const recall    = subset.length > 0 ? correct / subset.length : 0;
          return { cls, acc: correct / subset.length, precision, recall, n: subset.length };
        });
        const overall = groupData.filter(d => predict(d) === d.test_class).length / groupData.length;
        return { ...grp, metrics, overall };
      });

      // ── 4. Render results ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
      const panel = document.getElementById("results-panel");
      const grid  = document.getElementById("results-grid");
      if (!panel || !grid) return;

      const barColor = (acc) => {
        if (acc >= 0.8) return "#22c55e";
        if (acc >= 0.6) return "#f59e0b";
        return "#ef4444";
      };

      grid.innerHTML = "";
      results.forEach(grp => {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "metric-card";
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="metric-card-header">
            <span class="metric-group-dot" style="background:${grp.color}"></span>
            <span class="metric-group-label">${grp.label}</span>
            <span style="margin-left:auto;font-size:0.7rem;color:#64748b">Overall acc <strong style="color:#a5b4fc">${(grp.overall*100).toFixed(1)}%</strong></span>
          </div>
          <hr class="metric-divider">
          <div class="metric-rows">
            ${grp.metrics.map(m => `
              <div class="metric-row">
                <div class="metric-row-label">
                  <span class="metric-row-name">${m.cls} class (n=${m.n})</span>
                  <span class="metric-row-value">Acc ${(m.acc*100).toFixed(1)}%  ·  Prec ${(m.precision*100).toFixed(1)}%  ·  Rec ${(m.recall*100).toFixed(1)}%</span>
                </div>
                <div class="metric-bar-bg">
                  <div class="metric-bar-fill" data-val="${m.acc}" style="background:${barColor(m.acc)}"></div>
                </div>
              </div>
            `).join("")}
          </div>
        `;
        grid.appendChild(card);
      });

      // Hide empty state, show results
      const emptyEl = document.getElementById("results-empty");
      if (emptyEl) emptyEl.style.display = "none";
      panel.classList.add("visible");

      // Draw decision boundary on the chart
      window._drawBoundary && window._drawBoundary();
      window._drawTestChart && window._drawTestChart();

      // Animate bars with a small delay so CSS transition fires
      setTimeout(() => {
        panel.querySelectorAll(".metric-bar-fill").forEach(bar => {
          bar.style.width = (parseFloat(bar.dataset.val) * 100) + "%";
        });
      }, 60);

      if (btn) { btn.classList.remove("loading"); btn.querySelector(".btn-spinner").style.display = "none"; }
    }, 50);
  };
  return null;
}
